title: object-history cross-extension tests (blobext, conditional, emailpush)
description:
Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H12. Crates: jmap-testjig tests/. Size: S.

Spec: object-history-03 §3.1 (non-current versions are not blob references), §5.1; conditional-02 §3.1, §4; emailpush §3, §4. Design: docs/design/object-history.md §9, §10 'Cross-extension'; decisions 6(b), 10, 11.

Tests, over HTTP:
- Blobs: a blob referenced only by a destroyed Email ⇒ Blob/lookup returns empty, for both blob2 and legacy urn:ietf:params:jmap:blob (decision 11). Blob/set destroy then succeeds, after which Email/get includeDestroyed ⇒ notFound and restore ⇒ notFound (decision 6(d)).
- Conditional: ifUnchangedBy {"x": null} with restore of x succeeds. atomic:true with one failing restore ⇒ atomicFailure carrying notRestored, state unchanged, and no version left behind by the rolled-back restore (decision 6(b)).
- EmailPush: a restored Email sends no EmailPush. An EmailPushConfig with objectHistory in properties is echoed and stored without it (decision 10).

Acceptance: all of the above pass; oracles are hand-written.
